Title: Add docs/README.md — OctoAcme Project Management Documentation

This PR adds a central README to the docs/ folder that summarizes OctoAcme's project management processes and links to the existing process documents.

The README provides:
- Quick start guidance and links to the Project Management Overview
- A concise summary of each lifecycle phase: Initiation, Planning, Execution, Release, Retrospective
- Cross-cutting guidance (Risk Management & Communication, Roles & Personas)

Closes #2
